QuestInfo.name: [New Year's Event] New Year's Greetings For Dummies
QuestInfo.0:
Wee Moon Bunny says Maple families can exchange greetings to receive #e#bFamily Points (FP)#k#n. Collect Family Points every day and earn special prizes! 
(Remember, you get more points for sending greetings to players with a different family label.)
#e<How to Gain Family Points (FP)>#n
1) Right-click characters you want to exchange greetings with.
2) #rSelect 'Send Greeting'#k.
3) You receive Family Points (FP) when the recipient accepts the greeting.
